hypothesis: The mechanical cleavage energy required to separate graphite layers decreases as the number of layers decreases
prediction: The cleavage energy for a single-layer graphene sheet will be less than half that of bulk graphite
measurement_method: Measure the force required to mechanically cleave graphite samples with varying layer thicknesses (1 layer vs. bulk)
falsification_condition: If the cleavage energy for single-layer graphene is greater than or equal to half the bulk graphite cleavage energy
